verdict.rationale: Docs confirm SSH access to ODC instances is a primary connection method (docs-7), instances run standard Ubuntu with minimal preinstalled tooling giving high control (docs-4, docs-22, docs-42), and community evidence shows real-world usage of SSH into instances (docs-14, comm-3). Root-level control is implied by the 'high degree of control over your Python environment' framing and standard VM/SSH model, though not explicitly stated as root. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of root/sudo privileges and explicit statement about using custom SSH keys at launch.
